skill.summary: Use when a business is pricing by copying competitors, losing deals on price, or struggling to grow margins — to diagnose commoditization, justify a premium...

latestVersion.changelog:
Premium Pricing Strategy skill v1.0.0 introduces a structured approach to breaking out of commodity pricing and justifying premium prices.

- Diagnoses when an offer is commoditized and outlines necessary differentiation steps.
- Provides a step-by-step process to articulate and defend premium pricing using ROI and niche specificity.
- Introduces a practical multiplier framework, demonstrating how niche targeting increases perceived value and price.
- Lists essential information to gather before pricing, ensuring ROI-driven and value-focused price setting.
- Includes anti-pattern warnings to help businesses avoid common underpricing mistakes.
